summary: An excerpt from Kate Douglas Wiggin's Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm (labeled 'Book 11 — part 37') in which Rebecca Randall, alone at home at midday, decides to wear her aunts' newly finished pink gingham dress without asking. Emma Jane Perkins plans to wear her mother's garnet ring for a flag ceremony, and the two girls meet breathlessly at school, where Emma Jane remarks on Rebecca's appearance. The passage centers on Rebecca's vanity, the dress, and the girls' excited preparations for the day's event.
one_line: Rebecca Randall defies her absent aunts by wearing a new pink gingham dress to school, and Emma Jane admires her.
key_facts: Rebecca finds her lunch laid on the dining-room table and a note from aunt Jane saying they had gone to Moderation with Mrs. Robinson in her carryall.
The side door key is kept under the step, a hiding place known to everybody in Riverboro.
Aunt Jane had finished the pink gingham dress with her own kind hands and was making buttonholes on another item when Rebecca left.
Rebecca decides to wear the pink gingham without asking, reasoning that it is 'only gingham after all' and wouldn't be so grand if it wasn't new, trimmed with tape, and pink.
Rebecca leaves the three middle buttons of the dress unfastened, reserving them for Emma Jane to fasten.
Rebecca plans to carry her cherished pink sunshade, the exact match to the dress, wrapped in paper and only shown to the girls on the way home.
Rebecca unbraids her two pig-tails and ties her hair back with a ribbon before changing her shoes and putting on the dress.
Rebecca sees herself in the parlor looking-glass and is electrified by the vision of her appearance in the pink gingham.
It is twenty minutes to one when Rebecca dances out the side door, pulling a pink rose from a bush at the gate.
Rebecca covers the mile between the brick house and the school in an incredibly short time.
Emma Jane, also breathless and resplendent, meets Rebecca at the school entrance.
Emma Jane says 'Rebecca Randall! you're handsome as a picture!' and Rebecca replies that it is only the pink gingham.
Emma Jane plans to ask her mother to let her wear the garnet ring so it will look elegant flashing in the sun when she points to the flag.
Emma Jane's mother scrubbed the garnet ring in soap and water.
Emma Jane asks how Rebecca's aunt Mirandy allowed her to put on the brand-new dress.
